I can check that, but eligibility depends on the reason, so I need to know what went wrong with TX-0401. Which of these describes it?

- **Duplicate charge:** you were charged twice for the same TechMart Online purchase (the similar EUR 240.00 payment TX-0402 on 2026-07-14 may be the other charge).
- **Unauthorized debit:** you did not authorize this payment.
- **Card fraud (card not present):** someone used your card details online without your permission.
- **Goods not received:** you paid but the items never arrived.
- **Service not rendered:** you paid but the service was not provided.

Once you tell me, I will run the eligibility check. I will only open the dispute if you confirm and the check passes.
